sources.snippet: We introduce GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks ...

sources.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2 | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Overview GLM-5.2 is the newest model in the GLM-5 series — a ~743B-parameter MoE (39B active) from Z-AI. The headline change over GLM-5 / 5.1 is that Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is extended from 3 to 5 draft tokens, lifting end-to-end throughput on reasoning, coding, and agentic workloads. It ships as BF16, native-FP8, and AMD Quark MXFP4 checkpoints, and keeps the GLM thinking-mode ...
